args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary (Corvid blog + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.corvid.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/cold-chain/companion):

- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter (25%).
